notes: Added complete story set for Health Check Endpoint feature.

change_log.value: Health Check Schema and Response Contract

stories.title: Health Check Schema and Response Contract
stories.description: Define a standardized response schema for the /health endpoint including status, timestamp, and optional dependency indicators (e.g., MongoDB connectivity).

stories.title: Health Check Core Logic Implementation
stories.description: Implement backend logic to evaluate system health including app liveness and basic dependency checks (e.g., MongoDB ping using shared utilities).

stories.title: Expose /health FastAPI Endpoint
stories.description: Add a GET /health endpoint in main.py that returns the standardized health response and integrates with the core logic layer.

stories.title: Health Check Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating /health endpoint responses, including success and dependency failure scenarios.

per_feature.mitigation: Keep checks lightweight and non-blocking to avoid impacting runtime performance.
